title: SandboxSimulationRequest
description:
Bank transfer processing (omit body or `{}`), VAN transfer simulation (`type` virtual + transfers), or
verification directive simulation (`type` customer-verification, customer link, and errorCode). Typed bodies
are mutually exclusive; use only an omitted body or `{}` for bank processing.

SandboxSimulationBankProcessingRequest.title: SandboxSimulationBankProcessingRequest
SandboxSimulationBankProcessingRequest.description:
Omit the request body or send an empty JSON object (`{}`). Triggers processing (or failure) for the last
500 bank transfers on the authorized application or Sandbox account, and initiated micro-deposits.
Successful response is 200 with a HAL body including total.

SandboxSimulationCustomerVerificationReq.title: SandboxSimulationCustomerVerificationRequest
SandboxSimulationCustomerVerificationReq.description:
Simulate a verification directive for a business Verified Customer in Sandbox. The customer must be in
`retry` or `document` status. After a successful call, retrieve the Customer resource; the given `errorCode`
appears under `_embedded.errors`. See Dwolla documentation for verification directive meanings.

type.description: Must be set to customer-verification for verification directive simulation.

href.description: URL of the Sandbox customer to attach the simulated directive to.

errorCode.description: Verification directive to simulate for the linked customer.

SandboxSimulationVirtualAccountTransfers.title: SandboxSimulationVirtualAccountTransfersRequest
SandboxSimulationVirtualAccountTransfers.description:
Simulate Virtual Account Number (VAN) / external transfers in Sandbox. Up to 10 transfers per request;
transfers are created and processed immediately. Successful response is 202 Accepted.

type.description: Must be set to virtual for VAN transfer simulation.

SandboxSimulationVirtualTransferItem.title: SandboxSimulationVirtualTransferItem
SandboxSimulationVirtualTransferItem.description: One simulated external (VAN) transfer in a sandbox-simulations request.

_link.description: Link wrapper for the destination funding source (Dwolla HAL-style single link).
